title: How to choose a Shopify theme — what the demo doesn't show | UTD
description:
Every theme demo is staged — ours too. The demo you fall for is a finished store: full catalogue, studio photos, every section filled. Yours starts empty. So we build the other way round — themes that still hold together once your own products are in them.

Shown on real UTD theme demos: Fuse (preset bond — bags & leather goods), Ultra (preset grip — auto parts & tools), Gain (preset maison — furniture), Ultra (preset ultra — electronics).

Seven themes, five ready-made designs in each — 35 in total, from $100. Built by an official Shopify Partner team, with support that answers long after you launch. Try any theme free, with no time limit; you pay only when you publish your store.
👉 https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd
